question: If the height of a right circular cone is 24 cm and radius of its base is 10.5 cm, then the volume of right circular cone (in cm³) is: Takе л = (22)/(7)
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

The **Volume of a cone** is given by V = (1/3) × π × r² × h.

Since the volume includes π (22/7), the answer must be a **multiple of 11**.

Checking options: 2772 → (2 + 7) − (7 + 2) = 0. This is divisible by 11.

Calculation: V = (1/3) × (22/7) × 10.5 × 10.5 × 24 = 22 × 0.5 × 10.5 × 24 = 11 × 252 = 2772.

**∴ The correct answer is 2772 cm³.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height (h) = 24 cm

Radius (r) = 10.5 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a **Right Circular Cone** = (1/3) × π × r² × h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48543ab09d56341145ed85a3525a4bda5d5ff086f677719d0197570cc374231b.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × (22/7) × (10.5)² × 24

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × (22/7) × 10.5 × 10.5 × 24

⇒ Volume = (22/7) × 10.5 × 10.5 × 8

⇒ Volume = 22 × (10.5/7) × 10.5 × 8

⇒ Volume = 22 × 1.5 × 10.5 × 8

⇒ Volume = 33 × 84

⇒ Volume = 2772 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 2772 cm³.**

**__Additional Information__**

Slant Height of Cone

The distance from the apex to any point on the base circumference, l = √(r² + h²).

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The area of the side surface of the cone is given by π × r × l.

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The sum of the curved surface area and the area of the circular base, TSA = πr(l + r).

Volume Relation

The volume of a cone is exactly 1/3 of the volume of a **cylinder** with the same radius and height.</p
